title: Full onboarding wizard walkthrough from org setup to dashboard
description: Covers the real 5-step sequence implemented in app/(private)/onboarding/step-1..5: organization details -> framework picker -> cloud connect (skipped) -> invite team (skipped) -> completion screen.
steps: On /onboarding/step-1, select an industry and company size, click Continue
On /onboarding/step-2, select ISO 27001 and SOC 2, click Continue
On /onboarding/step-3, click 'Skip for now'
On /onboarding/step-4, leave the email input empty, click 'Skip for now'
Observe /onboarding/step-5 and click 'Go to Dashboard'
expectedResult: Each step advances to the next route in order; step-5 auto-marks itself complete on mount; the final click lands on /dashboard with all 5 steps present in completedSteps.

title: Completed steps remain checked after a hard browser refresh mid-wizard
description: OnboardingLayout (onboarding/layout.jsx) fetches /onboarding/state on every mount and passes currentStep/completedSteps into Stepper — a hard refresh must resume at the correct step, not reset to step-1 (AC-04.6 per the code comment).
preconditions: Steps 1 and 2 already completed; wizard currently on /onboarding/step-3
steps: While on /onboarding/step-3, hard-refresh the browser (F5, not client navigation)
Observe the Stepper header and current route after reload
expectedResult: The Stepper shows steps 1 and 2 as done (green check) and step 3 as active; the user is still on /onboarding/step-3, not redirected back to step-1.

title: Directly navigating to /onboarding/step-5 auto-completes step-5 but the Stepper reverts currentStep to step-1
description: Step5Page's useEffect unconditionally calls onboardingService.completeStep('step-5', {}) on mount (step-5/page.jsx lines 14-17) with no guard that steps 1-4 are done. Because onboarding.controller.js's nextStep() recomputes currentStep as the first ORDERED_STEPS entry missing from completedSteps, a completedSteps array of just ['step-5'] causes currentStep to resolve back to 'step-1'.
steps: As a logged-in onboarding session, navigate directly to /onboarding/step-5 by URL
Wait for the page's mount effect to fire
Call GET /api/v1/onboarding/state
Reload /onboarding (root wizard layout)
expectedResult: GET /state shows completedSteps: ['step-5'] and currentStep: 'step-1' — the wizard now shows step-1 as active despite step-5 being marked done, an inconsistent state worth flagging for remediation (step-5 should require steps 1-4 first, or its completion should not count until then).

title: Dashboard SetupChecklist widget reflects newly completed wizard steps within its 30-second poll window
description: SetupChecklist.jsx polls onboardingService.getState() every 30_000 ms while mounted (setInterval in the useEffect). Completing a step in another tab/session should be reflected here without a manual page reload.
preconditions: User is on /dashboard with the SetupChecklist widget visible, 2 of 5 steps complete
steps: In a second tab, complete step-3 via the wizard
Return to the dashboard tab and wait up to 30 seconds without reloading
expectedResult: Within one polling cycle (<=30s), the checklist item for step-3 flips to the checked/struck-through state and the Progress bar value increases to match the new setupHealthScore.

title: Dismissing the SetupChecklist widget only hides it for the current page load, not persistently
description: The CloseButton in SetupChecklist.jsx sets local component state (setDismissed(true)) — there is no call to persist a 'dismissed' flag anywhere in onboarding-state.model.js or onboardingService.js. A skipped/dismissed widget therefore reappears on the next navigation or reload, which may read as a 'skipped step reappearing as incomplete' defect from the user's perspective even though the underlying steps genuinely remain incomplete.
preconditions: Setup is incomplete (setupHealthScore < 100) so the widget is visible on /dashboard
steps: On /dashboard, click the CloseButton on the Setup Checklist widget
Confirm the widget disappears
Navigate to another page and back to /dashboard (or hard refresh)
expectedResult: The widget reappears after navigation/refresh because dismissal state is not persisted server-side or in localStorage — only in-memory React state for the current mount.

title: Skipping cloud connect and invite team still lets the wizard reach 100% step completion, but health score caps below 100
description: Both step-3's 'Skip for now' and step-4's zero-email submit call completeStep for their respective keys, so completedSteps ends up with all 5 keys even though no cloud account was connected. Per setup-health.service.js, without firstScanAt the max achievable score is 75 — the checklist widget (which only hides at >=100) will therefore never auto-hide for an org that skipped cloud connect.
steps: Complete step-1 and step-2 normally
On step-3, click 'Skip for now'
On step-4, click 'Skip for now' (no emails added)
Reach step-5 and go to the dashboard
Check the Setup Checklist widget's progress bar value
expectedResult: All 5 wizard steps show as done in the Stepper, but the dashboard's Setup Checklist widget remains visible indefinitely with its Progress bar stuck at 75%, since setupHealthScore never reaches 100 without a completed cloud scan.

title: Starting the platform tour walks through each configured step and positions the tooltip against the correct element
description: TourContext.jsx's navigateToStep() drives router navigation, waits for the target [data-tour] element to exist and have a non-zero rect, then sets targetRect with the step's declared 'place' (top/bottom/left/right) which TourTooltip/placeTip use to position the 330px-wide card and its arrow.
preconditions: User has not completed the platform tour (tourDone=false)
steps: Trigger startTour() (e.g. from a 'Take the tour' entry point)
Click 'Next ->' through at least 3 TOUR_STEPS entries that live on different routes
Observe the tooltip position and arrow direction relative to each step's target element
expectedResult: For each step, the app navigates to the step's route, the tooltip renders adjacent to the correct [data-tour] element per its configured 'place', the arrow points at the spotlighted element, and the step counter (e.g. '3 / N') matches the current position.

title: Skipping the platform tour marks it done and redirects to /project-management
description: skipTour() calls markDone(), which sets tourDone in localStorage and via onboardingService.updatePlatformTourStatus({ tourDone: true }), then explicitly router.push('/project-management') (TourContext.jsx lines 170-179).
preconditions: Platform tour is currently active, on any step
steps: While the tour tooltip is visible, click 'Skip' (or the X close icon)
Observe the resulting route and re-check GET /platform-tour/status
expectedResult: The browser navigates to /project-management; the tour overlay unmounts; GET /platform-tour/status now returns tourDone: true for this user.

title: A brand-new organization sees the full uncompleted wizard immediately after signup, with no prefilled data
description: signup.controller.js creates OnboardingState with completedSteps: [] inside the same transaction as the Organization/User/Project — a fresh tenant must never inherit partial progress from another org or a cached template.
steps: Complete POST /onboarding/signup for a brand-new org/domain/email
Immediately log in with the bootstrap token and open /onboarding
Call GET /api/v1/onboarding/state
expectedResult: The Stepper shows all 5 steps as pending, the wizard lands on step-1, and GET /state returns completedSteps: [], currentStep: 'step-1', setupHealthScore: 0 — no step appears pre-checked.

title: A returning user whose org already has data sees the checklist as fully or partially complete, not reset to zero
description: Complements ONBD-E2E-009: an org that finished (or partially finished) onboarding in a prior session must show that persisted state on next login, not the fresh-tenant zero state.
preconditions: Org completed steps 1, 2 and 3 in a previous session; setupHealthScore = 60
steps: Log in as a user of that org on a new browser session (no localStorage cache)
Open /dashboard and observe the Setup Checklist widget
Open /onboarding and observe the Stepper
expectedResult: The Setup Checklist widget shows steps 1-3 checked and its Progress bar at 60%; the Stepper shows the same 3 steps done with step-4 active — both reflect the DB-persisted state, not a reset.
